name: codex-command-quiet
description: Run shell commands through a Rust MCP tool that discards stdout and stderr.

interface.shortDescription: Run commands with no stdout or stderr
interface.longDescription: Adds a Rust MCP server with a run_quiet tool. The tool executes a requested shell command, discards its stdout and stderr, and returns only a concise status.
defaultPrompt: Run this command quietly and return only its status.
